sourceData.meaningMnemonic: If you use the <radical>sun</radical>, you can find the <radical>correct</radical> <radical>geoduck</radical>. That's the <kanji>topic</kanji> of today's lecture.
sourceData.readingMnemonic: Our <kanji>topic</kanji> is actually mostly about using the sun to see different colored <reading>dye</reading>s (<ja>だい</ja>) in the water.
sourceData.meaningInfo: Picture a teacher pointing to a chalkboard with a big pointer, and it says "TOPIC."
sourceData.readingInfo: You use the dye in the correct sunlight to find the geoducks hiding under the sand. And once we master this topic, we'll move onto actually using dye to find them in the wild.
